messages.subject: unable to download the package with a R version 3.3.1
parts:
Dear methylKit users,
I am trying with no success to download the methylKit on a cluster but I keep having that warning:

Warning message:
package ‘methylKit’ is not available (for R version 3.3.1)

methylKit require to have a R version > 3.3.0 so I don't understand.
I installed it successfully on my computer yesterday after upgrading my R version but it seems not working on the cluster.

would you have some advices?
Many thanks
Sincerely
Alice Mouton

I suggest you try to install as it is instructed in github not via bioconducor biocLite()

best,
Altuna
